info.title: Coffee Bean Origin Classifier
info.summary: One photo of whole coffee beans in, the likely country of origin out.
info.description: Send one photo of whole coffee beans, green or roasted. The answer scores every country the model knows, or refuses when the photo does not look like the beans it was trained on. Free, no key. The photo is never stored. At most 40 MB and 60 megapixels a photo (camera RAW: 16 megapixels). One photo at a time for everyone: on a busy 503, wait about 10 s and retry, and never send photos in parallel; on an offline 503, try again in a few minutes. A cross-origin caller, a script on a page of any site, may call it and read the answer (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, X-Request-Id exposed, no credentials); that site should tell its visitors their photo is sent here. Guide for agents: https://coffee.kasetkin.com/llms.txt

externalDocs.description: What the model knows and how it works

post.summary: Classify the country of origin of the coffee beans in one photo
post.description: The answer is JSON objects, one per line (NDJSON), streamed: the preview, the photo as the model reads it, once the photo is converted (about 1-3 s); then the segmentation, where the beans are (about 5 s in all); then the classification (about 9 s in all). Read to the end of the stream: the classification, or an error part, is always the last line. A refusal before the stream (too large, not an image, unreadable, busy) is an HTTP status; once the preview has gone out, the classifier offline or busy, or a failure, is an error part.

photo.description: The image file, at most 40 MB and 60 megapixels (camera RAW: 16 megapixels): JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, JPEG XL, GIF, BMP or camera RAW (DNG, CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF, RW2, PEF, SRW). A RAW file needs its usual extension in the filename. An animated GIF is read as its first frame. Colour is read from the file's ICC profile (a PNG's cICP colour tag comes first), else its colour tag (HEIC/HEIF and AVIF nclx) or JPEG XL header, else a JPEG's Adobe RGB EXIF tag, else as sRGB; an HDR photo (PQ or HLG) is tone-mapped into standard range; a JPEG XL with an embedded ICC profile is refused. Best: a handful of whole beans filling most of the frame.

skip_crop.description: Send 1 to classify the whole photo instead of the beans the server finds in it.

200.description: Up to three lines: a PreviewPart (left out when the server could not make it), a SegmentationPart, then a ClassificationPart; an ErrorPart instead of the lines still to come if the server failed or the classifier could not take the photo after the stream began.

schema.description: The schema of one line: the body is newline-delimited JSON, each line one of these.

400.description: No photo was uploaded, or the file could not be read as an image.

413.description: The photo is larger than 40 MB, or has more pixels than its limit.

503.description: Not analyzed now, for one of two reasons told apart by the body. Busy: another photo is being analyzed, with {"error": "the classifier is busy with another photo"} or a body that is not JSON; wait about 10 s and retry. Offline: {"error": "the classifier is offline"}, the classifier is down or being updated; try again in a few minutes, not in a loop. Once the preview has gone out, either comes as an ErrorPart with outcome busy or offline instead.

PreviewPart.description: The photo as the model reads it, sent before the photo is analyzed. Display only; an agent can skip it.

jpeg.description: The photo in sRGB, long side at most 1024 px.

SegmentationPart.description: Where the beans are, to draw over the preview. Display only; an agent can skip it.

mask.description: The bean region over the whole photo, long side at most 1024 px; null when none was used.

seg_fallback.description: No usable bean region was found, so the whole photo is classified.

box.description: The crop as fractions of the photo: [x0, y0, x1, y1]; null when not cropped.

needs_review.description: The crop may have missed the beans.

verdict.description: predicted: ranked holds the answer. warned: the same, but say it is unsure (see warning). refused_ood: the photo does not look like coffee beans the model knows; there is no country to report. refused_unreadable: the photo could not be read as beans.

ranked.description: Every country the model knows, best first. Present for predicted and warned.

label.description: The country's name, to show a person.

score.description: The model's probability; the scores sum to 1.

warning.description: Why the answer is unsure: Uncertain, Uncertain framing, or both. Present for warned.

message.description: A short reason, for the refusals.

outcome.description: Present when the classifier did not answer after the preview went out: busy (wait about 10 s and retry), offline (try again in a few minutes) or failed. Absent: the classification itself failed.
